title: 第23章  咬痕第24章  别碰我疼
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
季欢听到谢烬沉和谢老爷子的话，偷偷瞄了一眼谢京墨脖子上的咬痕。
她脸蓦地一红，她想到了她咬他时的那种感觉。
那个时候，她都快死了。
所以，没轻没重的，也想报复回去。
谢京墨冷厉的眸子里有着一抹冷笑，看到了某个雌性红了脸。
都是她干的好事！
这小雌性一生气，就爱乱咬人，脾气还不小。
他要的狠了，她还挠他，他背上全是她挠出来的痕迹。
季欢低头吃早餐，根本不敢与他对视。
但她也能感觉到，某个家伙一直盯着她看，那两道目光侵略性很强。
谢京墨淡声说：“我没有女朋友。”
谢烬沉却笑他，“小叔，你脖子上那是咬痕，我们都知道是怎么来的，你就别藏着掖着了。我也想见见我未来的小婶长什么样？”
说到这里，他跟季欢说。
“姐姐，你是不是也想见一见小婶？”
季欢吃着早餐，听到他的话，她呛到了。
“咳咳咳……”
谢烬沉赶紧给她递了一杯温水。
季欢喝了水后，才把那食物给咽下去，她有些难受。
刚刚她把自己代入了那个小婶的角色。
因为咬谢京墨的人就是她。

不过，她不可能和谢京墨有什么的？
那家伙，怎么可能会娶她？
而且她一个小说里的恶女，应该没有好下场的，她只愿能活到结局，然后回她的世界去了。
谢京墨看她紧张的样子，嘴角勾了勾，竟然露出了一抹浅笑。
谢烬沉看到他笑，一脸惊恐。
他小声跟季欢说：“我竟然看到我小叔笑了，他竟然也会笑，啊！太恐怖了。”
季欢也觉得有点恐怖，那样严肃的人也会笑吗？
两人在一边小声说着，画面实在是亲昵。
谢老爷子倒是没注意，他现在更关心自己的小儿子，是不是真的女朋友了。
他不承认，那么他得让人去查了。
如果真有钟意的对象，刚好可以把他的婚事给办了。
他也老大不小的了。
谢京墨看到两人凑近说话，还有说有笑的，特别季欢笑起来的样子。
嗯，比在他身下哭好看多了。
谢京墨冷声说：“季小姐，一会我顺便送你，烬沉他以后都要在老宅里待着了。”
谢烬沉也知道自己要留在老宅受教训，可是他送了季欢再回来就行了。
content_en:
When Ji Huan heard what Xie Jinchen and Mr. Xie said, he secretly glanced at the bite marks on Xie Jingmo's neck.
She blushed suddenly, thinking of the feeling when she bit him.
At that time, she was almost dead.
Therefore, no matter how serious it is, I also want to take revenge.
There was a sneer in Xie Jingmo's cold eyes, and he saw a certain female blushing.
It's all her fault!
This little female likes to bite people when she gets angry, and she has quite a bad temper.
He wanted it hard, and she even scratched him. There were marks all over his back.
Ji Huan lowered his head to eat breakfast, not daring to look at him at all.
But she could also feel that a certain guy had been staring at her, and those two eyes were very aggressive.
Xie Jingmo said quietly: "I don't have a girlfriend."
Xie Jinchen laughed at him, "Uncle, there are bite marks on your neck. We all know how they came about, so don't hide them. I also want to see what my future aunt looks like?"
Speaking of which, he told Ji Huan.
"Sister, do you also want to meet my aunt?"
Ji Huan was eating breakfast and choked when she heard his words.
"Cough cough cough..."
Xie Jinchen quickly handed her a glass of warm water.
Ji Huan drank the water before swallowing the food. She felt a little uncomfortable.
She had just assumed the role of the aunt.
Because she was the one who bit Xie Jingmo.
However, it is impossible for her to have anything to do with Xie Jingmo?
How could that guy marry her?
Moreover, she is a villain in a novel and should not have a good ending. She just hopes to survive until the end and then return to her world.
Seeing her nervous look, Xie Jingmo curled up the corner of his mouth and revealed a faint smile.
Xie Jinchen looked horrified when he saw him smiling.
He whispered to Ji Huan: "I actually saw my uncle smiling, and he actually laughed too, ah! It's so scary."
Ji Huan also found it a bit scary. Would such a serious person laugh?
The two of them were whispering to each other, and the scene was really intimate.
Mr. Xie didn't pay attention. He was now more concerned about whether his youngest son was his real girlfriend.
If he doesn't admit it, then he has to ask someone to investigate.
If you really have someone you like, you can arrange his marriage.
He is also quite old.
Xie Jingmo saw the two of them talking closely and laughing, especially Ji Huan, who was laughing.
Well, it looks better than crying under him.
Xie Jingmo said coldly: "Miss Ji, I'll see you off later. Jin Shen will stay in his old house from now on."
Xie Jinchen also knew that he had to stay in the old house and learn a lesson, but he could just send Ji Huan away and come back.
